title: 第28章  你自己闯的祸，自己去收拾
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
通往山峦别院的路上。

    苏定安脚下生风，身如飞雁，一路向前疾驰。

    袖子里面几两碎银叮叮当当响了一路，都快掉出来了，可他顾不上。

    银子是小，若是陆大人有个闪失，那可就出大事了。

    赵衡是什么人？

    青州镇魔司在册九年，镇魔校尉中的翘楚，死在那把镇魔铁扇之下的妖魔没有几千也有数百。

    他待人谦和有礼，不代表是个软骨头。

    听听人家那外号，明礼扇，摆明了是先礼后兵。

    陆大人入门不到一个月，怎么就惹上了这种人物？

    他苏定安贪生怕死又爱财，在镇魔司内跟谁都能聊几句，但谁也不愿跟他交心。

    唯独陆大人不一样。

    外出办差，工钱是工钱，赏钱是赏钱。

    不仅不嫌他贪生怕死，交差时候还会算他一份协办的功绩。

    安，飘零半生，未逢明主，若是陆大人有个什么闪失......

    他内心焦灼不已，灵力疯狂涌动，修炼七年的逍遥御风诀催动到极致。

    劲风在耳边呼啸，脚下一步快过一步。

    终于，赵衡的别院出现在视线之中。

    他深吸一口气，正要上前——

    嗯？

    他眼皮一跳，脚步猛地刹住，只见一道人影从院中走出。

    衣衫整齐，气息平稳，身上连一丁点的凌乱都没有。

    苏定安惊得下巴都快掉了，眼里满是惊愕。

    “陆......大人？您没事儿？”

    陆渊拂去袖口尘埃，衣角微脏。

    苏定安咽了咽口水，往他身后的院子里看了一眼。

    里面静悄悄的，一点动静都没有。

    “赵衡呢？”

    “在里面躺着。”

    “昂？什么意思？”

    “就是他可能还得再睡一会儿。”

    苏定安的嘴彻底合不上了。

    他瞪大眼睛看着陆渊，像是在看一个妖魔。

    那可是赵衡啊，镇魔校尉中的翘楚，竟然被一个刚入司的新人打昏迷了？

    亏他还火急火燎地跑去演武堂搬救兵，现在想想，这个救兵到底是给谁搬的还真不好说。

    陆渊看着苏定安满头大汗的样子，问道：“你去哪儿了？”

    苏定安露出一个讪讪的笑，“我这不是怕赵衡下手太狠，去通知沈大人了嘛。”

    沈墨是青州镇魔司的总教头，几乎所有镇魔卫都受到过他的点拨，当然也会卖他几分面子。
content_en:
On the road leading to the mountain villa.

    The wind was blowing under Su Dingan's feet, and his body was like a flying goose, galloping forward.

    A few taels of broken silver jingled all the way inside his sleeve and almost fell out, but he didn't care.

    The money is small. If Mr. Lu makes a mistake, something big will happen.

    Who is Zhao Heng?

    He has been in the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division for nine years and is the leader among the Demon Suppression School Lieutenants. Hundreds or thousands of demons have died under the Demon Suppression Iron Fan.

    Just because he is courteous and courteous to others does not mean he is a weakling.

    Listen to his nickname, Ming Li Fan, which makes it clear that he should be polite before fighting.

    Mr. Lu has been here for less than a month, how come he got into trouble with such a person?

    Su Ding'an is greedy for life and loves money. He can chat with everyone in the Demon Suppression Department, but no one wants to have a heart-to-heart relationship with him.

    Only Mr. Lu is different.

    When you go out on business, your wages are wages and rewards are rewards.

    Not only does he not think he is greedy for life, but he will also be credited with co-organizing the work during the assignment.

    An, I have been wandering for half my life and have never met my master. If Mr. Lu makes any mistake...

    He was anxious in his heart, his spiritual power surged crazily, and the Xiaoyao Wind Control Technique that he had practiced for seven years was pushed to the extreme.

    The strong wind whistled in my ears, and each step was faster than the next.

    Finally, Zhao Heng's other courtyard appeared in sight.

    He took a deep breath and was about to step forward——

    Huh?

    His eyelids twitched, his steps suddenly stopped, and he saw a figure walking out of the courtyard.

    His clothes were neat, his breathing was steady, and there wasn't even the slightest bit of mess on his body.

    Su Ding'an was so shocked that his jaw almost dropped, and his eyes were filled with astonishment.

    "Sir... Lu? Are you okay?"

    Lu Yuan brushed off the dust from his sleeves, and the corners of his clothes were slightly dirty.

    Su Ding'an swallowed and glanced at the yard behind him.

    It was quiet inside, with no movement at all.

    "Where's Zhao Heng?"

    "Lie inside."

    "Ang? What do you mean?"

    "It's just that he might have to sleep a little longer."

    Su Ding'an couldn't close his mouth at all.

    He stared at Lu Yuan with wide eyes, as if looking at a demon.

    That was Zhao Heng, the leader among the demon-suppressing captains, but he was beaten unconscious by a newcomer who had just joined the department?

    Fortunately, he rushed to the martial arts hall to move reinforcements. Now that he thought about it, it was hard to say who the reinforcements were for.

    Lu Yuan looked at Su Ding'an sweating profusely and asked, "Where have you been?"

    Su Ding'an gave a sly smile, "Aren't I afraid that Zhao Heng will be too harsh, so I went to inform Mr. Shen."

    Shen Mo is the chief instructor of the Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division. Almost all the Demon Suppression Guards have been instructed by him, and of course they will give him some face.
title_en: Chapter 28 You caused the trouble yourself, clean it up yourself
